quote: Martin was a great instructor and I really felt like I came away with some food for thought and some new ideas to try in my daily life. Doing the quiz before hand meant I got some real insight into my own thought processes and how they both benefit and hinder me at work. I only wish I had been able to attend a training like this earlier in my career - I would recommend this to anyone!
author: Voirrey Blount
subject: Soft Skills Training
